spacing_and_layout.strategy: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol - Mode B (High Density)
spacing_and_layout.general_rules: Mobile-First (grid-cols-1). Override default stretch with align-items: start where needed. Always use ample internal padding (p-6) in bordered containers.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-[#E5E5E5]), no shadow by default. On hover: -translate-y-1 and shadow-lg.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border. Never transparent.
surface_strategies.grid_borders: Use border-collapse layout for dense data tables. Subtly expose the grid skeleton for a technical look.

component_rules.buttons: Sharp corners or very subtle rounding (rounded-sm). High contrast (Black background, White text for primary). Explicit hover states (hover:bg-[#262626] hover:text-white).
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Never native HTML inputs. Left-align inputs. Left-align labels.
component_rules.tables: Dense rows. Use Shadcn Table. Distinguish 'Paid' vs 'Pending' using semantic status badges (E.g., soft green bg for paid, soft yellow for pending).
component_rules.toasts: Use Sonner component for all notifications (e.g., 'Factura enviada por email').
component_rules.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts for 'IVA repercutido vs soportado' visualization. Minimalist styling, 1px lines.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Required on all interactive elements. Use transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion_and_interactions.lists: Staggered entrance animations for invoice rows.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A0A0A]).

iconography.style: Duotone weight for high-end tech feel.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not apply generic 'transition: all' anywhere. Apply to specific properties.
Do not center align the app container. Text and data must naturally flow from the left.
Build for React (.js), do not use TypeScript (.tsx). Modify Shadcn outputs appropriately.
Ensure all data grids, inputs, and buttons include 'data-testid' for robust testing.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use real styling or Phosphor icons as fallbacks.
For the header, do not use a transparent background over content.
Ensure contrast checks pass APCA standards. Normal text must be clearly legible on #FAFAFA background.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a responsive Dashboard displaying total IVA (collected vs paid), total expenses, and the next tax deadline (e.g., Modelo 303 quarterly dates: April 20, July 20, Oct 20, Jan 20).
Implement 'Crear Factura' form with client NIF/CIF, multiple line items, IVA type selector (21%, 10%, 4%, 0%, Exento), and IRPF toggle/percentage.
Implement an Invoice List with PDF download (can mock PDF generation with simple window.print or a lightweight lib) and an 'Enviar por Email' mock button that triggers a Sonner toast.
Implement 'Registro de Gastos' table for entering vendor bills, which subtracts from the IVA to pay.
Ensure all Shadcn components are adapted for JS and Tailwind without TypeScript artifacts.
Install missing dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react sonner recharts clsx tailwind-merge framer-motion
